```{r}
library(tidyverse)
```


import raw data
```{r}
data_url = "https://www.kamishima.net/asset/sushi3-2016.zip"

raw_dir = "raw"
zip_path = file.path(raw_dir, "sushi3-2016.zip")

# Create the raw data folder
dir.create(
  raw_dir,
  recursive = TRUE,
  showWarnings = FALSE
)

# Download only if the ZIP file is not already present
if (!file.exists(zip_path)) {
  download.file(
    url = data_url,
    destfile = zip_path,
    mode = "wb"
  )
}

# Unzip only if the main data files are not already present
required_files = c(
  "sushi3.udata",
  "sushi3.idata",
  "sushi3a.5000.10.order",
  "sushi3b.5000.10.order",
  "sushi3b.5000.10.score"
)

raw_data <- file.path("raw", "sushi3-2016")
required_paths = file.path(raw_data, required_files)

if (!all(file.exists(required_paths))) {
  unzip(
    zipfile = zip_path,
    exdir = raw_dir
  )
}

cat("Raw data are available in:", raw_data, "\n")
print(list.files(raw_dir))

# 确认下载完成
if (!all(file.exists(required_paths))) {
  stop(
    "Some required data files could not be found after extraction: ",
    paste(
      required_files[!file.exists(required_paths)],
      collapse = ", "
    )
  )
}


```

users
```{r}
users = read_tsv(
  file.path(raw_data, "sushi3.udata"),
  col_names = FALSE,
  show_col_types = FALSE
) |>
  set_names(
    "user_id",
    "gender",
    "age_group",
    "completion_time",
    "childhood_prefecture",
    "childhood_region",
    "childhood_east_west",
    "current_prefecture",
    "current_region",
    "current_east_west",
    "moved_prefecture"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    # 用来之后和setA和setB链接join的
    respondent_row = row_number(),

    gender = factor(
      gender,
      levels = c(0, 1),
      labels = c("male", "female")
    ),

    age_group = factor(
      age_group,
      levels = 0:5,
      labels = c(
        "15-19",
        "20-29",
        "30-39",
        "40-49",
        "50-59",
        "60+"
      )
    ),

    moved_prefecture = factor(
      moved_prefecture,
      levels = c(0, 1),
      labels = c("same", "different")
    )
  ) |>
  relocate(respondent_row, user_id)

# Data checks
stopifnot(nrow(users) == 5000)
stopifnot(n_distinct(users$user_id) == 5000)
stopifnot(n_distinct(users$respondent_row) == 5000)
```
